test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes. 

School, Teacher, Employee
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relations is as follows :-

 
• Some Employee work in School.
 
• Some Teacher work in school.
 
• All Teacher are Employee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae2c57028636c38b2192f7b6a4f6479a410b73b806892cd57a7ce94696dd0ee.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
